purpose: Determine whether the 5-message free-tier quota is tracked per-account (shared) or per-token/session (bypassable via multiple independent logins).

step1_baseline.note: Both fresh at 5/5 - inconclusive alone, both would show 5 whether shared or separate.

step2_after_sending_1_message_via_token_.conclusion: Token A's remaining also dropped to 4 despite the message being sent via Token B only. Quota is enforced at the ACCOUNT level, not per-token. No bypass via multiple independent login sessions.
